<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z ≈199 and a nearly equal intensity peak at m/z ≈201, a classic 1:1 M and M+2 pattern characteristic of bromine. No other element exhibits such a distinctive isotopic signature in this data. Therefore, bromine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
